column1: # Defines superseded by a later revision of the same target (#239).
# spike/cohort3/PROTOCOL.md is explicit that "a define revision is a new
# target directory", so every revision is a define in its own right and the
# A-group's "every committed, runnable define" would admit all of them. This
# file is the decision not to: for each target, the corpus carries the last
# revision and the earlier ones are recorded here, by name, with what
# replaced them.
# The criterion is narrow on purpose. A row belongs here only when a LATER
# REVISION OF THE SAME TARGET exists and is in the corpus — count.py check
# verifies the successor is a corpus row, so this file cannot be used to
# park a define for any other reason. Defines excluded because their class
# is not supported go in class-exclusions.tsv instead; those targets were
# not replaced by anything, and recording them as superseded would be false.
# What this rule costs is recorded in BUILDLOG.md rather than here. A rule
# file that argues about which way it moves the published number is evidence
# that the number was in view when the rule was written.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   predecessor  successor  reason
# Paths are the define directory, repo-relative — the same unit as the
# corpus's defines column.
